query: how Online Semi-Supervised Learning helps in adaptive machine learning systems?
ground_truth_answer: Online semi-supervised learning (SSL) helps adaptive machine learning systems by allowing them to learn from a small amount of labeled data and a large amount of unlabeled data in real-time. This is particularly useful in dynamic environments where data distributions change, as the model can continuously adapt and improve its performance without needing extensive manual labeling. It combines the benefits of supervised learning (accuracy from labeled data) and unsupervised learning (scalability with unlabeled data) in an online setting.
